title: Design lifecycle
finding: Discover research, Define brief, Develop prototype, Validate evidence, Deliver production package, Govern lifecycle. Visual Communication Receive verified inputs → Execute → Review → Handoff. Historical project crosswalk, not external universal standard.

title: Brand Strategy and Identity
finding: Audit/research → strategy platform → architecture → verbal system → creative direction → visual identity → applications → rollout/governance. Each responsibility has deliverables and acceptance scope.

title: Creative Direction vs Art Direction
finding: Creative direction supervises assignment, creative territory, concept and cross-discipline direction; art direction interprets visual treatment, briefs assets, oversees production and proof. Cross-cutting roles are not one project stage.

title: Typography vs lettering/type design/font engineering
finding: Typography handles reading hierarchy, type selection, composition, script proof and specification. Lettering does not imply complete typeface; custom type/font engineering require activated scope. Font licensing is separate.

title: Information Design workflow
finding: Model entities, relations and priorities; structure hierarchy/navigation; choose representation; test comprehension; publish. Outputs include maps, forms, reports and dashboards according to need. Accuracy and accessibility are separate QA criteria.

title: Editorial / Publication Design workflow
finding: Intake production brief; publication system; layout proofs; asset integration/rights; correction; medium-specific production and distribution. Do not equate layout system with content model.

title: Scope activation
finding: Illustration, motion, packaging, experiential/wayfinding, custom fonts and licensing are conditional responsibilities; not mandatory outputs merely because they are related disciplines. Preserve planned stages 15–21 separately from present roots 01–14.

title: Rejected exact raster wrapper
finding: Attempt 04 v1.1 preserved screenshot visually but did not reconstruct vector lettering or master document frame. Actual production source must be distinguished from review image.

title: Typography medium-collapse failure
finding: v0.19 PDF was paginated web specimen, resulting in whitespace, composition and broken dependency. Design print and screen anatomy independently.

title: Five claimed graphic asset families
finding: v2.1 user-rejected: one silhouette transformed into five supposed families; technical separation substituted for specialist review; final gate premature.

title: Graphic language learned gate lineage
finding: Attempt 02 created/updated Gates 002,007,008,009,011: scope, independence, family distinctness, rejection preservation and role separation.

title: Graphic Language approval
finding: Exact v3.2 user approval recorded 2026-09-14; limited to Gaafar Atlas. The record itself requires subsequent canonical persistence and freeze verification; no new freeze assertion.

title: Stage 13 arrow encoding rejection
finding: Bilingual relationship diagrams imposed LTR direction, competed with verb labels and used line styles without useful meaning. Choose relation-specific geometry, not automatic arrows.

title: Stage 13 semantic model
finding: Stable definitions distinct from historical exact-state records; explicit CurrentStatePointer resolves manifest and artifacts rather than recency. Candidate, review, verification, freshness, completeness, authority and transition states independent.

title: Evidence-derived completion
finding: Required acceptance and assurance obligations provide explicit denominator. Missing, stale or failed required verification blocks completion; conditional N/A needs trigger evidence. Corrections link to objections or failed verification; preserve previous results.

title: Stage 13 exact approval basis
finding: 2026-09-25 approval: O13R-01 v0.8 semantic model, O13R-02 v0.3 navigation/state map, O13R-03 v0.4 decision/evidence trace, O13R-04 v0.4 assurance register, O13R-05 v0.1 representation spec; V13R-01 11/11 reported. Approval record explicitly requires later freeze/persistence; Atlas transfer not implied.

title: Stage 14 exact readiness
finding: v1.2 readiness reports 7/7 outputs, 52/52 required requirements, 75/75 output assurance, 22/22 content conditions, 4/4 benchmark families, 27 specialist reviews, 7/7 pre-user-review exit obligations. user_approved=false, frozen=false. Historical reported outcomes not rerun.

title: Maximum applied validation
finding: Inventory materially distinct accessible applications; prioritize user corpus, then open cases expanding stress dimensions; evidence-backed dispositions; no fixed case count. Missing saturation evidence blocks stage exit; freeze scope and reopening matter.
